promos.title: Weather System
promos.body: One time and weather for every player, with ten sky looks, Starfall, Aurora and Meteors at night, a Hurricane that crosses the city and earthquakes that shake the streets. Admins run it from /weather, every setting is in Script Studio, and it is free.

promos.title: Speaker System
promos.body: Handheld speakers, placed stereos, beam and strobe lights that keep time with the music, and car dash tablets with an optional subwoofer. Everything is played and linked from the Speaker Connect phone app, and every setting is in Script Studio.

promos.title: Taxi Job V2
promos.body: A complete FiveM taxi job featuring a custom MLO, taxi organizations, phone app, in-game Taxi Creator, progression, achievements, leaderboards, and player-driven rides.

promos.title: End of summer sale
promos.body: Every GG script, and everything that ships after this, for less until the end of the month.

promos.title: Three copies of gg_taxijob
promos.body: Drop a reaction on the pinned post in Discord. Three winners drawn live on stream when it closes.

promos.title: Support has moved to Discord
promos.body: Tickets, updates and drops all go through the server now. The old support email is closed.

promos.title: Spring sale
promos.body: Every GG script for less, all of April.
